newsitem.title: USA: Apple retains CEO executive search firm.
newsitem.headline: Apple retains CEO executive search firm.

text.p: Apple Computer Inc. said Tuesday it retained the executive search firm Heidrick & Struggles Inc. to help it find a new chief executive officer.
Earlier this month, Gilbert Amelio resigned as Apple's chief executive officer amid criticism he had failed to come up with a solid turnaround strategy.
Apple, based in Cupertino, Calif., said it did not know when it would find a successor, although such searches typically take about 90 days.

The company said Heidrick & Struggles will work closely with an Apple search committee to seek a CEO who is both "a strong leader and a hands-on manager, with a successful sales and marketing background, an established industry knowledge and reputation, and the ability to create, execute and inspire."
Apple's stock rose 40.6 cents to $16.56 on Nasdaq.
